ucs.title: [LLM] Turla ComRAT v4 — WMI-persisted orchestrator beaconing to Gmail web UI for C2
ucs.description: Hunts ESET-documented ComRAT v4 (Secret Blizzard / Snake) behaviour: a PowerShell or rundll32 loader spawned by WmiPrvSE.exe (Event Subscription persistence) that subsequently reaches mail.google.com / apis.google.com from a non-browser process — Turla's signature Gmail-as-C2 channel where commands are exfil'd via Gmail cookies and inbox drafts.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="WmiPrvSE.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe") AND (Processes.process IN ("*FromBase64String*","*IEX*","*Invoke-Expression*","*Reflection.Assembly*","*DownloadString*") OR Processes.process IN ("*rundll32*.dat,*","*rundll32*.tmp,*","*rundll32*.bin,*","*rundll32*.log,*")) by host Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join host [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as dns_count values(DNS.query) as gmail_query min(_time) as dns_firstTime from datamodel=Network_Resolution.DNS where DNS.query IN ("mail.google.com","accounts.google.com","apis.google.com") by host | `drop_dm_object_name(DNS)` ] | where dns_firstTime >= firstTime AND dns_firstTime <= firstTime+7200 | table firstTime, dns_firstTime, host, user, parent_process_name, process_name, process, gmail_query, dns_count | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let SuspiciousWmi = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "WmiPrvSE.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("FromBase64String","IEX","Invoke-Expression","Reflection.Assembly","DownloadString")
    or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)rundll32\.exe\s+[\"']?.+\.(dat|tmp|bin|log|cfg)[\"']?,"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project WmiTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          WmiChild=FileName, WmiCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let GmailC2 = DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("mail.google.com","accounts.google.com","apis.google.com","www.googleapis.com")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe","safari.exe","OneDrive.exe","Teams.exe","OUTLOOK.EXE")
| project NetTime=Timestamp, DeviceName,
          NetProc=InitiatingProcessFileName, NetCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP;
SuspiciousWmi
| join kind=inner GmailC2 on DeviceName
| where NetTime between (WmiTime .. WmiTime + 2h)   // ComRAT polls Gmail within minutes of orchestrator launch
| project WmiTime, NetTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, WmiTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName,
          WmiChild, WmiCmd, NetProc, NetCmd, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP
| order by WmiTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SuspiciousWmi = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\WmiPrvSE.exe"
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\rundll32.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("FromBase64String","IEX","Invoke-Expression","Reflection.Assembly","DownloadString")
    or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)rundll32\.exe\s+.+\.(dat|tmp|bin|log|cfg),"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project WmiTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          WmiChild=NewProcessName, WmiCmd=CommandLine;
let GmailC2 = DnsEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Name in~ ("mail.google.com","accounts.google.com","apis.google.com","www.googleapis.com")
| project DnsTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, DnsQuery=Name, ClientIP;
SuspiciousWmi
| join kind=inner GmailC2 on Computer
| where DnsTime between (WmiTime .. WmiTime + 2h)
| project WmiTime, DnsTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', DnsTime, WmiTime),
          Computer, SubjectUserName, WmiChild, WmiCmd, DnsQuery, ClientIP
| order by WmiTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\WmiPrvSE.exe OR *\\wmiprvse.exe OR *\\WMIPRVSE.EXE) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*FromBase64String* OR *frombase64string* OR *IEX* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *Reflection.Assembly* OR *DownloadString*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/WmiPrvSE\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|rundll32)\.exe$/i
| regex("(FromBase64String|IEX|Invoke-Expression|Reflection\\.Assembly|DownloadString|rundll32\\.exe.+\\.(dat|tmp|bin|log|cfg),)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(mail\.google\.com|accounts\.google\.com|apis\.google\.com|www\.googleapis\.com)$/i}, field=aid, include=[DomainName, ContextImageFileName])
ucs.rationale: ComRAT v4 (ESET 2020, attributed to Turla / Secret Blizzard) is the only well-documented APT framework that combines (a) WMI Event Subscription persistence launching a small PowerShell/rundll32 loader for the orchestrator with (b) using the Gmail web UI as a bidirectional C2 channel by replaying stolen cookies from a non-browser process. ucs.title: [LLM] Turla LightNeuron — Exchange Transport Agent backdoor installation
ucs.description: Hunts ESET-documented LightNeuron (Turla / Snake / Venomous Bear) persistence on Microsoft Exchange: an unsigned (non-Microsoft) DLL written under \TransportRoles\agents\, or PowerShell invoking Install-TransportAgent / Enable-TransportAgent referencing a non-vendor assembly. LightNeuron is the only known APT mail-server implant of this design; the same TTP applies to Turla's later Exchange-side tooling.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\TransportRoles\\agents\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Exchange Server\\V15\\TransportRoles\\*") AND Filesystem.file_name="*.dll" AND Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified","renamed") by host Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | eval source_event="transport_dll_drop" | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*Install-TransportAgent*" OR Processes.process="*Enable-TransportAgent*") by host Processes.process Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process as file_path | eval source_event="transport_agent_install" ] | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path="*\\TransportRoles\\Shared\\agents.config" AND Filesystem.action IN ("modified","created") by host Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | eval source_event="agents_config_edit" ] | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let TransportAgentDrop = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where FolderPath has @"\TransportRoles\agents\" 
   or FolderPath has @"\Exchange Server\V15\TransportRoles\"
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
| where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName !has "Microsoft"      // LightNeuron drops unsigned/non-MS assemblies
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("trustedinstaller.exe","msiexec.exe","setup.exe","ExSetup.exe","ServiceModelReg.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatorImage=InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatorCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatorAccount=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatorVendor=InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
          Source="TransportAgentDllDrop";
let TransportAgentInstall = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Install-TransportAgent","Enable-TransportAgent")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType="ProcessCreated",
          FileName="", FolderPath="", SHA256="",
          InitiatorImage=FileName,
          InitiatorCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatorAccount=AccountName,
          InitiatorVendor="",
          Source="TransportAgentInstallCmd";
let AgentsConfigEdit = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActionType in ("FileModified","FileCreated")
| where FolderPath has @"\TransportRoles\Shared\" and FileName =~ "agents.config"
| where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName !has "Microsoft"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatorImage=InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatorCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatorAccount=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatorVendor=InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
          Source="AgentsConfigEdit";
union TransportAgentDrop, TransportAgentInstall, AgentsConfigEdit
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let InstallCmd = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("Install-TransportAgent","Enable-TransportAgent")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp=TimeGenerated, Computer, Account=SubjectUserName,
          ActionType="ProcessCreated", FilePath="",
          Image=NewProcessName, Cmd=CommandLine,
          Source="TransportAgentInstallCmd";
let DllDrop = ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventType =~ "FileCreated" or EventType =~ "FileModified" or EventType =~ "FileRenamed"
| where TargetFilePath has @"\TransportRoles\agents\"
     or TargetFilePath has @"\Exchange Server\V15\TransportRoles\"
| where TargetFileExtension =~ "dll" or TargetFileName endswith ".dll"
| where ActingProcessName !endswith "\\TrustedInstaller.exe"
     and ActingProcessName !endswith "\\msiexec.exe"
     and ActingProcessName !endswith "\\ExSetup.exe"
| project Timestamp=TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, Account=ActorUsername,
          ActionType=EventType, FilePath=TargetFilePath,
          Image=ActingProcessName, Cmd=ActingProcessCommandLine,
          Source="TransportAgentDllDrop";
let ConfigEdit = ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventType in~ ("FileModified","FileCreated")
| where TargetFilePath has @"\TransportRoles\Shared\" and TargetFileName =~ "agents.config"
| project Timestamp=TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, Account=ActorUsername,
          ActionType=EventType, FilePath=TargetFilePath,
          Image=ActingProcessName, Cmd=ActingProcessCommandLine,
          Source="AgentsConfigEdit";
union InstallCmd, DllDrop, ConfigEdit
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Turla LightNeuron Exchange Transport Agent Installation
id: 9c4c8fb1-7c3d-4f5a-b8c0-2a1e6d7e4f3b
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell invocation of Install-TransportAgent or Enable-TransportAgent on Exchange — Turla's LightNeuron backdoor persists by registering itself as a transport agent. Combine with file-write telemetry under \TransportRoles\agents\ for higher fidelity.
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2019/05/07/turla-lightneuron-email-too-far/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1505/002/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/28
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.002
  - attack.g0010
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Install-TransportAgent'
      - 'Enable-TransportAgent'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_image and selection_cmd and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Approved Exchange administrators installing vendor anti-spam / DLP transport agents (validate Assembly path is signed by the vendor)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon ((@EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\TransportRoles\\agents\\*.dll OR *\\TransportRoles\\agents\\*.DLL OR *\\TransportRoles\\Shared\\agents.config)) OR (@EventID:1 @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe) @CommandLine:(*Install-TransportAgent* OR *Enable-TransportAgent*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=FileWritten regex("\\\\TransportRoles\\\\(agents|Shared)\\\\", field=TargetFileName, flags="i") regex("\\.(dll|config)$", field=TargetFileName, flags="i") NOT ContextImageFileName=/(TrustedInstaller|msiexec|ExSetup|ServiceModelReg)\.exe$/i)
OR (#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i regex("(Install-TransportAgent|Enable-TransportAgent)", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: LightNeuron (ESET 2019) is Turla / Venomous Bear's only publicly-documented Exchange mail-server backdoor and is one of the only known APT implants to weaponise the Microsoft Exchange Transport Agent extensibility surface (T1505.002).
